title: OpenAI launches Jalapeno chip for AI inference workloads #openai #jalapeno #aitech
description:
OpenAI launched its own AI chip, Jalapeno, designed specifically for running inference workloads that power ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API. Built in partnership with Broadcom, this chip marks OpenAI's first step towards full-stack control of their AI infrastructure, moving away from reliance on Nvidia for compute.

By developing custom silicon for inference rather than training, OpenAI aims to reduce costs and increase efficiency in serving responses billions of times a day. Owning the hardware layer allows them to better optimize performance and scalability, which is critical for sustaining rapid growth and expanding AI-powered products.

This shift reflects a broader trend in the AI industry where leading companies are investing in proprietary chips to gain competitive advantages in cost, speed, and control of their AI ecosystems. OpenAI’s move could influence market dynamics by accelerating vertical integration in AI technology stacks.
